name: Seaweed / kelp foods (nori, wakame, kombu, dulse — dried, as sold)

MeHg.label: Methylmercury is a component of total mercury (MeHg ≤ tHg). No government sets a methylmercury limit for this product below the binding total-mercury ceiling (100 µg/kg), so methylmercury is governed by and bounded by the total-mercury ceiling; no separate methylmercury ceiling is published.

Cr.label: No government sets a total-chromium ML for seaweed. Read-across to the nearest food total-chromium ML on an as-sold dry basis (China GB 2762 milk powder, 2000) as a monitor/baseline. Total chromium in edible seaweed is predominantly non-toxic Cr(III) from mineral accumulation, so the binding health control is hexavalent chromium (Cr-VI); total chromium is monitored, not a per-lot pass/fail.
Cr.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Cr-VI.label: No government sets a hexavalent-chromium ML for food. Read-across to the California SWRCB drinking-water Cr(VI) MCL (10) as a conservative oral-intake species ceiling, kept below the total-chromium value. Marine chromium is Cr(III); Cr(VI) in seaweed is negligible, so clean product passes and a chromate-contaminated sample fails.
Cr-VI.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Sn.label: Tin is a can-migration analyte; dried seaweed foods are sold in non-metal packaging with no tinplate contact, and no government sets a tin ML for seaweed. Read-across to the EU 2023/915 general canned-food inorganic-tin ML (200000) as a packaging-migration baseline; with no tin source clean product passes, and a mispackaged or contaminated sample fails.
Sn.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

Al.label: No government sets an aluminium contaminant ML for food; dietary aluminium is managed by weekly intake against the EFSA/JECFA TWI. Read-across to the nearest food aluminium instrument (China GB 2760 baked-foods aluminium, 100000) as a monitor/baseline ceiling. Seaweed accumulates aluminium naturally; this ceiling flags gross contamination while clean product passes. Flagged monitor/baseline, not per-lot-critical.
Al.basis_note: face value (nearest government value; comparator vs any direct limit)

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default, 8:1 basis, read-across)
